title: Native capture runner needs a declared GlyphSDF route
body: To capture the localized GlyphOutline sign on native Vulkan, I manually extended native-capture.sh and native-capture.ps1 with a glyphsdf localized-sign state, its CTest regex, and per-scene artifact cleanup. The route is duplicated across shell and PowerShell instead of being declared by the registered capture test. Add one shared capture-route manifest or generate both runner branches from CTest metadata so future capture scenes require no paired script edits.

title: Queue estimate misses cold Dozen GlyphOutline shader memory
body: The queued Dozen correctness capture at 1920x1080 estimated 875 MB but reached 36.4 GB RSS at 7:25 before writing a frame; it was manually interrupted (queue exit 76, WRAPPER_SIGNALED, payload 141). Retrying the same CTest with VIXEN_RENDER_SCALE=0.5 still reached 38.4 GB RSS at 5:54 without a frame. The full production shader path for fixed-bucket glyph recipes has a large cold working set that render-scale does not bound, so the GPU queue estimate and correctness capture path do not reflect the actual cost. Suggested consolidation: include cold pipeline compile peaks in admission estimates and provide a focused Dozen correctness witness that avoids compiling the entire look-dev graph.

title: Native Windows build drops a selected UNDERTOW_ROOT
body: The native build runner started cmd.exe without forwarding the caller's UNDERTOW_ROOT, so CMake discovered the machine's stale Undertow checkout even when Linux configuration used the current main-wave schema. Workaround: export core/src from origin/main-wave under the VIXEN worktree and invoke UNDERTOW_ROOT=<that root> bash reports/capturespeed/reproduce/native-build.sh; the runner now translates and forwards it with wslpath.

title: Native queue cancellation leaves a Windows build lock behind
body: The queue job was interrupted with Ctrl-C while its Windows build was active: wrapper exit 76 (WRAPPER_SIGNALED), payload 143. The WSL wrapper exited but the child run_build_with_summary.ps1, cmake, ninja and cl.exe processes remained, holding Global\VixenBuildLock. After checking no other native build was active, recovery used taskkill /PID 154076 /T /F, then acquired and released the abandoned mutex; the next queued build proceeded. Suggested consolidation: propagate queue cancellation to the Windows process tree and treat AbandonedMutexException as an acquired mutex that must be released.

title: Native Undertow UNC root breaks CMake glob verification
body: With UNDERTOW_ROOT set to the current main-wave export, native CMake found the correct schemas.json, but the Windows backslash UNC path was written into CMakeFiles/VerifyGlobs.cmake as a string containing \U and failed: Invalid character escape '\U' at VerifyGlobs.cmake:1004. Exact failing command: UNDERTOW_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/VBVS--VIXEN/.claude-worktrees/glyphsdf/.tmp/undertow-main-wave-full-c663dace1137 bash reports/capturespeed/reproduce/native-build.sh (queued build log 1792074705-build-nativerunner:native-build-22eeb1268ed8.log). Workaround: normalize wslpath -w output to forward slashes before passing the root; verify the queued build regenerates VerifyGlobs cleanly. Suggested consolidation: normalize cross-platform path inputs before embedding them in generated CMake script strings.

title: Look-dev voxel capture manually compensates for normalized octree scale
body: The GlyphSDF analytic-versus-stored capture had to convert from the baker's 128-grid coordinates to the renderer's normalized [0,1]^3 body frame, which is expanded to 10 local units. Treating grid coordinates as renderer coordinates made the baked sign appear as a tiny mark. The capture now uses 0.30*128/10 and centers from the normalized midpoint. Suggested consolidation: expose a shared helper that builds a stored instance transform from bake resolution and desired world scale, so scene and capture code do not repeat this coordinate contract.

title: Visual evidence workflow lacks contact-sheet image tooling
body: To prepare the required run4 visual contact sheet,  failed with ModuleNotFoundError, and ffmpeg, ImageMagick, rsvg-convert, and browser renderers were not installed. I had to write a one-off standard-library PNG decoder/resizer/compositor. Suggested consolidation: provision a supported lightweight image tool or expose a capture-report helper that assembles contact sheets from the native PNGs.

title: Look-dev GlyphSDF camera distance is a fixed scene-specific value
body: The capture hardcoded a 9.5-unit orbit radius, leaving a single sign at about half of the 1920x1080 frame width. The R574 visual review required repeated manual camera adjustment and recapture. Suggested consolidation: derive camera framing from the authored sign bounds and target frame occupancy, while preserving a separate fit rule for multi-object comparison frames.

title: Native capture runner needs configurable pipeline cache reuse
body: Each VIXEN SHA gets a fresh runtime-cache directory, so the first native GlyphSDF capture recompiles the Vulkan pipeline set. To recover, I manually set VIXEN_CACHE_DIR to a prior native build cache in a queued PowerShell CTest run; it warmed earlier pipelines but later stalled on the scene-specific shadow pipeline. The native-capture script clears inherited VIXEN_* variables and exposes no cache-root option. Suggested consolidation: add an explicit cache-seed/root option to the runner and keep the cache device-UUID validated.

title: Native capture needs heartbeat for long Vulkan pipeline calls
body: The queued command VIXEN_NATIVE_QUEUE_RESOURCE=gpu-native bash reports/capturespeed/reproduce/native-capture.sh --label GlyphSdfProofPair was killed after 198 seconds without CPU/output at shadow_visibility_wave_pipeline, while CTest allows 1800 seconds. A one-off 30-second PowerShell heartbeat kept the same gpu-native CTest alive until its own 1800-second timeout. Suggested consolidation: add periodic liveness/phase output to the native capture wrapper or configure the queue for long synchronous driver calls.

title: GPU-native cancellation must terminate Windows capture descendants
body: After gpu-native idle-hard cancellations of the queued pair CTest, vixen_lookdev_capture.exe remained running after the PowerShell/WSL wrapper exited; I found stale child processes with PIDs 204208, 182040, and 30564 and working sets up to 1.4 GB. The native attempts overlapped those orphaned processes until I stopped them with Stop-Process/taskkill. Suggested consolidation: cancellation must terminate and await the full Windows process tree before freeing the GPU slot.

title: Require visible geometry in stored-SDF capture witnesses
body: The existing Application.LookdevCapture.StoredSdf.Brickmap test passed with a uniform-background frame even with a fixed camera aimed at the stored-SDF instance. That made the previous visual witness vacuous; I added a dedicated neutral-lit analytic/stored sphere fixture with geometry bounds in frame. Suggested consolidation: make stored-SDF capture tests assert a minimum non-background/hit-pixel area and provide a standard visible recipe fixture.

title: Native capture script depends on caller working directory
body: The command bash reports/capturespeed/reproduce/native-capture.sh --label GlyphSdf256 --gpu-benchmark failed with exit 127 from the VIXEN/ source subdirectory because the reports path is relative to the repository root. Running the same command from the repository worktree root entered the shared gpu-native queue. Suggested consolidation: resolve the runner path from the script or repository root, or document and validate the required working directory.

title: Headless RmlUi tests need a shared font-engine fixture
body: The Dozen correctness run failed in ViewHudGolden, HudViewTest, and ViewBlobEquiv at Rml::Initialise with No font engine interface set because each headless fixture registered only system and render interfaces. I registered Vixen::Text::RmlFontEngine in those three fixtures, matching production UIRenderNode and test_ui_hud_smoke. Suggested consolidation: add one reusable headless RmlUi fixture that owns and registers the system, render, and font interfaces before initialization.

title: Native capture runner needs per-run diagnostic environment overrides
body: The registered ShadowBiasOneVoxel label fixes VIXEN_SHADOW_CONFIG_BIAS_EPSILON at 0.15, while native-capture.sh accepts only a CTest label and cannot select the 0.30/0.45 probes. To run the controlled bias sweep without changing CMake and rebuilding a new SHA, I invoked vixen_lookdev_capture.exe --gtest_filter=LookdevCapture.RendersSdfFilterNonText directly under with-test-lock.sh --resource gpu-native --gpu-benchmark, manually copying the CTest environment and setting the bias variable. Add a declared per-run environment override to the native capture route while keeping its PATH, temp, Vulkan, and queue setup.

title: Look-dev SDF captures inherit host shadow diagnostic overrides
body: The standard SDF compare CTest entries did not unset VIXEN_SHADOW_CONFIG_ENABLED or VIXEN_SHADOW_CONFIG_BIAS_EPSILON. A host-level diagnostic override was inherited by both before and after captures, masking the renderer change; make scene capture environments explicit and allow per-case overrides only for isolation tests.
